sources.quote: Nonconformance report NCR-26-017. Supplier: Minuterie Germanasca (SUP-G). Status: open.
Lot 26-0412 of CL-115 clips in C67S spring steel measured 52 HRC, tolerance 44-50 HRC.
Block the lot, 100% hardness check on the next three lots, keep Germanasca as source.

findings.why: The proposed change doubles the December CL-115 order. CL-115 is supplied by Germanasca (SUP-G), which has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of this part: hardness 52 HRC against a tolerance of 44-50. The NCR is still open, and the 100% check on the next three lots is still running. The NCR is therefore an open quality issue on the part's material at this supplier.

The proposed change doubles the December CL-115 order. CL-115 is supplied by Germanasca (SUP-G), which has an open NCR on the C67S spring steel of this part: hardness 52 HRC against a tolerance of 44-50. The NCR is still open, and the 100% check on the next three lots is still running. The NCR is therefore an open quality issue on the part's material at this supplier.
